runs.content: International Consolidated Airlines Group picked up at today's previous close (430.30 GBX, ~$5.75) — deep value screen (P/E 7.43, earnings yield 19.36%, ROIC 27.47%), benefiting from crude at an 11-day low (its largest cost line), H1 2026 revenue/margin/cash flow all improved. EVTC was exited discretionarily (−6.52%, −$65) to keep the book at 35 open positions after IAG's entry — HUM and OTIS were both passed over despite weaker P&L on fresh positive-thesis grounds. CRWD hit T2 today (+50.33%, $249.35) — second 1/3 sold, final 1/3 runs uncapped; NVO crossed −10.66% WATCH, no Burry conflict, held. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,484 (+2.32% on $64,000).

Fortinet picked up at today's previous close ($169.84) — Q2 2026 revenue +26% YoY beat, named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Hybrid Mesh Firewall, riding a broad cybersecurity-sector rally (Zscaler +16%+, FTNT +9% Sept 14) on AI-agent-security demand distinct from Burry's AI-capex short thesis. PEP was exited discretionarily (−8.58%, −$86) to keep the book at 35 open positions after FTNT's entry — no mechanical stop-losses or signal exits on the other 33 continuing positions; AMAT recovered sharply on today's chip-sector rally, from −8.90% to −2.97%, clearing the Burry sector-warning signal-exit concern flagged yesterday. EVTC is now the weakest continuing position at −7.09%, no Burry conflict. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,436 (+2.28% on $63,000).
